title: Remote Work Policy
content: Employees of Acme Corp are permitted to work remotely up to five days per week. All remote work must be conducted from a suitable home office environment. Employees must be reachable during core hours of 10:00 to 16:00 in their local time zone. Equipment necessary for remote work, including a laptop and peripherals, will be provided by the company. Employees working remotely must attend all mandatory team meetings via video call. Any employee wishing to work from a co-working space must receive prior approval from their direct manager. Remote work privileges may be revoked for performance issues at the manager's discretion.
